headline: When the Chore Chart Stops Working
title: Chore Chart for Kids Not Working? Make the Next Step Easier
description: When the chore chart stops working, shrink the job. Missed a day? Start with today and skip yesterday’s boxes. Busy week? Keep one job, like the plate to the sink. Pushback? Turn “clean your room” into “books back on the shelf” and practice again. A skipped job is usually too big or not taught yet.
